research.notes: Agenda says 'San Francisco Coalition of Essential Schools'; the registered name is 'Essential Small Schools'. Name differs by one word but the acronym SF-CESS and Oakland location match. The organization's website emphasizes San Francisco and Bay Area events, while the IRS/ProPublica address city is Oakland. No street address was found on the website; no website page mentions OUSD.

profile.legalName: San Francisco Coalition Of Essential Small Schools
profile.summary: SF-CESS is a nonprofit that supports schools and communities in identifying and addressing inequities in education. It offers discussion card decks, equity-focused facilitator training and tools, and an annual Fall Forum for educators.
